meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并跟踪多步工作,自动恢复中断进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用智能助手处理复杂工作,希望它记住计划与进度,中断后也能恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-step agent work on track with saved plans; resume after interruptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you delegate complex, multi-step jobs to AI agents and want them to pick up where they left off.

howto.what: Claude 会在你的项目目录里创建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件，把计划、发现和进度写进磁盘；每完成一个阶段就更新，做重大决定前先重读计划，出错也记进计划文件。
howto.when: 当你要求规划或拆分多步项目、做研究任务，或这项活需要 5+ 次工具调用时它会接管；在 /clear 之后也能靠读回这些计划文件恢复上下文。

say.text: 先建 task_plan.md，把这个多步任务拆成几个阶段
say.note: 会在项目根目录生成三个规划文件

say.text: 读一下当前计划，我们再继续下一步
say.note: 它会先读 task_plan.md 再动手

say.text: 把刚查到的资料写进 findings.md
say.note: 外部内容只写 findings.md，不写进计划

howto.what_en: Claude creates task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project folder, writes plans, findings and progress to disk, updates them after each phase, re-reads the plan before major decisions, and logs errors into the plan file.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to plan or break down a multi-step project or research task, or when the work needs 5+ tool calls. After /clear it can also restore context by reading those planning files.

say_en.text: Create task_plan.md first and split this multi-step task into phases
say_en.note: Creates three planning files in your project root

say_en.text: Read the current plan, then let's continue with the next step
Write what you just found into findings.md
say_en.note: External content goes only to findings.md
